capabilities: create inline input fields (e.g. toggles) inside notes
bind fields to frontmatter properties and keep them in sync
display frontmatter properties in notes with view fields
extras: Detailed documentation lives on an external docs site; the plugin also ships an offline FAQ/Help page accessible via a command or the settings page.
problem: Obsidian's frontmatter properties can only be edited in the properties area, so interactive controls inside note content cannot read or change note metadata.
summary: Plugin that adds inline input fields, view fields, and buttons inside notes, bound to and synced with frontmatter properties.
